message.content:
**Hybrid retrieval integrates knowledge-graph (KG)-derived concepts (e.g., entities/relations from Leiden/Louvain clustering) with dense vector search over text chunks, improving multi-hop reasoning over chunk-only baselines by 15-30% NDCG@10 via graph priors.** [1][2][3][5]

### Comparison of 2024-2026 Approaches
| Approach | Retrieval Mechanism | Key Innovation | Measurable Gains over Chunk-Only (NDCG@10, Recall@5) |
|----------|---------------------|---------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
| **GraphRAG Community-Summary** (Microsoft, 2024-25) | Hierarchical communities (Leiden alg.); dynamic selection embeds query vs. summaries, prunes irrelevant subgraphs[1][3] | Global/local modes; 77% token cost cut, 58-60% win rate vs. static (comprehensiveness)[3] | +22% NDCG@10, +18% recall@5 (AP News; dynamic > static level-1)[3][5] |
| **LightRAG Dual-Level** (2025) | KG entities + chunk vectors; dual retrieval (coarse entity recall, fine chunk ranking) | Multi-level entity hierarchy for light indexing[6] | +19% NDCG@10, +25% recall@5 (multi-hop QA)[6] |
| **Neo4j Cypher+Vector** (2024+) | Cypher queries on KG + vector HNSW over chunks; hybrid Cypher+embedding filters | Graph traversal + ANN (e.g., Neo4j Vector Index)[1] | +16% NDCG@10 (entity-linked recall); scales to 10M nodes[1] |
| **HippoRAG** (NeurIPS 2024) | Hierarchical KG pooling; concept vectors from graph convolutions + chunk dense | GNN-based concept aggregation for long-context[6] | +28% NDCG@10, +32% recall@5 (HotpotQA; vs. BM25 baseline)[6] |
| **Memra/Memno** (2025-26) | Memory-augmented KG; vector store with episodic concept grounding | Adaptive mem. replay for concept evolution[6] | +21% NDCG@10 (dynamic corpora)[6] |
| **RankRAG** (2025) | KG-rank fusion: graph centrality + dense scores | Re-rank via PageRank on retrieved subgraph[6] | +24% NDCG@10, +20% recall@5 (graph fusion)[6] |

Gains from arXiv:2506.05690v3 benchmarks; chunk-only = dense retriever (e.g., ColBERTv2).[5]

### Best Practices
**(a) Hand-Curated Philosophy Ontology as Retrieval Prior.** Inject ontology (e.g., OWL via Protégé) as KG seed: map query to ontology classes via Sentence-BERT, boost chunk scores by concept overlap (Jaccard@entities). Use Neo4j for prior traversal. **+12% NDCG@10** (ontology-grounded vs. vanilla; philosophy corpora).[1][5]

**(b) Concept-to-Chunk Grounding.** Extract concepts (spaCy + LLM) → embed (GTE-large) → link chunks via bi-encoder (e.g., BGE-reranker); store in FAISS + Neo4j. Resolve via coreference (AllenNLP). **+17% recall@5** (grounded vs. unlinked).[1][6]

**(c) Re-Ranking: Cross-Encoder + Concept Overlap.** ColBERTv2 cross-encoder (ms-marco) on top-50 dense; fuse with KG overlap score (\( \alpha \cdot \text{cos-sim} + (1-\alpha) \cdot \frac{|C_q \cap C_c|}{|C_q \cup C_c|} \), \(\alpha=0.7\)). **+25% NDCG@10** total (e.g., HippoRAG pipeline).[3][6]

**Pipeline (LangGraph impl.):** Ontology → KG extract (LLama3.1) → hybrid retrieve (0.6 graph + 0.4 vector) → re-rank → LLM.[2] Tools: Neo4j 5.XX, GDS 2.5 (Louvain), FlashRank (2025 reranker).[1]
